note: Domains are self-declared; we have not verified who operates them.
rule: A domain is counted when a person found a named operator on its pages (operator_named, with basis_url and checked_at), its operator_name is not an insider of the operator or Yakumo (insider_name), and it is not in NOT_COUNTED.json. matched_operators counts the distinct operator_name of counted domains with an ok row, per runner; own counts those rows of origin own.
